column1: # Aliases for lineage nodes. Generated 2026-10-06 by rule, filtered to forms the
# corpus actually uses, so every row is attested.
# Rules: declared acronym, and the node_id when acronym-shaped; plural and
# singular; the `X network` / `X neural network` / `X net` alternation; the
# `long form (ACRONYM)` shape the extractor emits; squashed and hyphenated
# CLAIM PRIORITY is what makes this safe. 0 = a canonical node name, 1 = a
# declared acronym, 2 = plural/singular of those, 3 = a generated morphological
# variant. Lowest wins; ties are REJECTED, never guessed.
# The neural-naming alternation is GUARDED to lineages whose effective
# connectivity is actually neural. Unguarded, it assigned `bayesian neural
# networks` to the `Bayesian network` (directed graphical model) node. A
# Bayesian neural network is a different thing, and it is not a lineage node at
# all -- the merge dropped it when Bayesian weights became an attribute -- so
# that string has no lineage home and belongs in the generic-description
# bucket, pinning attributes=Bayesian with connectivity from the paper.
# No fuzzy matching anywhere: token-set matching once paired `gpt-j` with
# `GPT-4` after stopword removal collapsed both to a single token.
